facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) on Friday approved French billionaire Xavier Niel's proposal to acquire a 16.2% stake in UK-based telecom major Vodafone Group Plc, news agency PTI reported.
facts.text: The Competition Commission of India cleared Xavier Niel's proposed acquisition of a 16.2% stake in Vodafone Group Plc.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The deal, valued at around €5.1 billion, involves the purchase of the stake by Vega SAS, Niel's family investment vehicle, from Emirates Telecommunications Group Co PJSC.
facts.text: The transaction between Vega SAS and Emirates Telecommunications Group is valued at approximately 5.1 billion euros.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: In July, Vega SAS announced a binding agreement with Emirates Telecommunications Group Co PJSC for the acquisition, valued at approximately 4.4 billion pounds (5.1 billion euros).
facts.text: The cash consideration agreed for Vega SAS to acquire the Vodafone stake is approximately 4.4 billion British pounds.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The CCI also approved three other corporate transactions on Friday.
facts.text: The competition regulator cleared 3 other major corporate transactions alongside the Vodafone Group stake purchase.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The watchdog also approved Adani Energy Solutions' proposed acquisition of 100% of IntelliSmart Infrastructure from the National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF) and Energy Efficiency Services Ltd, as per BS.
facts.text: Under the approved corporate transactions, Adani Energy Solutions received clearance to acquire a 100% stake in IntelliSmart Infrastructure.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: These include the sale of its businesses in Italy and Spain, the divestment of its 50% stake in a Dutch joint venture and its merger with Three to create the UK's largest mobile operator.
facts.text: Vodafone Group has been restructuring globally, having previously sold a 50% interest in a Dutch joint venture.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Currently, Airtel leads the market with an ARPU of ₹275, followed by Jio (₹216), and Vodafone Idea (₹177).
facts.text: Vodafone Idea generates an average revenue per user of 177 rupees per month from its mobile consumer base.

facts.label: analyst-view
facts.quote: Axis Capital expects a “broad-based 10-12% industry tariff hike over the next six months”, supporting telcos' tariff-repair strategy.
facts.text: Brokerage Axis Capital projects an industry-wide tariff hike of 10% to 12% over the next six months that will impact consumer recharge bills.

facts.label: reported
facts.text: The CCI has approved French billionaire Xavier Niel's €5.1 billion deal to acquire a 16.2% stake in Vodafone Group through his investment vehicle Vega SAS. The acquisition, from Emirates Telecommunications Group, will make Vega Vodafone's largest shareholder.
